Container.Name: Cuesheet
Container.Overview: Cuesheet is a calm media dashboard for your server: what's playing on Plex and Jellyfin right now, what was recently added, what Radarr and Sonarr expect this week, and a box to request new media through Overseerr or Jellyseerr. Requests are made in Overseerr or Jellyseerr itself; Cuesheet shows what has been asked for and links straight through. Open the web UI after starting and a setup wizard walks you through connecting each service and testing it. Everything about your services is configured inside Cuesheet, so there is nothing to fill in here beyond the port and a folder for its settings. All API keys stay inside the container, stored in the config folder. The browser only ever talks to Cuesheet.
Container.Changes:
### 2.0.0
- Live bandwidth: a total for the server plus a figure on every stream. - Plex and Jellyfin streams are tinted in each server's own colour. - Requests are made in Seerr; the dashboard shows the queue and links across. - Busy calendar days scroll instead of stretching the week. - Sign-in removed: the dashboard is open to anyone who can reach it.
### 1.1.0
- Services are configured inside Cuesheet rather than here. - Recently added scrolls sideways and its length is a setting.
### 1.0.0
First release.
